lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: There's a crate out the back that came off the campus truck and isn't on the campus manifest. I checked — I check, it's a habit, I used to do goods-in.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Two of the things that were inside it are now outside it. Nobody in here wants to call it in, because calling it in means admitting out loud that we all know what a manifest looks like and we have all been reading them.

choices.text: Call it in. It is not your crate.
